verification.label: Verification
verification.description: Anti-bot gate: a button or image captcha grants the verified role that unlocks the server.

feedback.disabled: ❌ Verification is disabled on this server.
feedback.notConfigured: ❌ Verification isn't ready yet (no verified role set). Please tell an administrator.
feedback.cannotAssign: ❌ I can't grant you the verified role. An administrator must check my permissions (Manage Roles + hierarchy).
feedback.captchaInstructions: 🔐 Copy the code shown on the image, then click “Enter code”. Case does not matter.
feedback.captchaWrong: ❌ Wrong code. Try again by clicking “Enter code”.
feedback.captchaExpired: ⌛ The captcha expired. Click “Verify” again to get a new one.
feedback.success: ✅ Verified, welcome! You now have access to the server.

g0.label: 🔐 Verification
g0.description: After any change, republish the panel with the “Publish” button.

channelId.label: Verification channel
channelId.help: The welcome channel the verification panel is posted in. It should be the only one an unverified newcomer can see, otherwise verification protects nothing.

roleId.label: Role granted once verified
roleId.help: The role granted after verification, the one that opens the server. Without it, verification succeeds and changes nothing. It must sit below the bot's role to be grantable.

method.label: Method
method.help: « Button » is enough against the simplest bots and asks nothing of the member. « Captcha » shows an image to type back: it also stops automated accounts, at the cost of roughly one newcomer in ten needing a second try.

content.label: Content
content.help: The panel's body text. Say why this step exists: a newcomer asked to copy an image with no explanation often leaves instead.

buttonLabel.label: Button label
buttonLabel.help: The text of the button that starts verification.

logChannelId.label: Log channel
logChannelId.help: A channel recording each verification, passed or failed. Repeated failures seconds apart are the signature of a bot wave — this is where you see it. Empty, nothing is kept.
